capabilities: Navigate the vault through a page sidebar with pinned entries, projects, search, tags and bookmarks
Render compact Notion-style Bases tables and boards with covers, colored tags, thumbnails and linked records
Aggregate unfinished Markdown tasks and page deadlines into a reminders page grouped by due date
Create uniquely named pages directly and rename them via the native page title without dialogs
Toggle between the enhanced appearance and native Obsidian fonts, spacing and file explorer
disambiguation: Despite the name, not a focus or distraction-blocking tool; it restyles the whole workspace as a Notion-like interface over Markdown and Bases.
extras: Distributed via GitHub Releases and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.14.5+; this release targets macOS desktop and iPhone only — Android, iPad and third-party themes are not validated. No network service, telemetry or AI integration; the bundled font carries a separate SIL OFL license.
intentEvidence: Some Bases enhancements depend on internal view structure and retain native controls when unrecognized.
motivation: The author wanted to make local Markdown easier to browse and edit, taking navigation and typography cues from Codex and ChatGPT's mobile layout while keeping notes as plain Markdown, properties and links.
problem: Obsidian's native file explorer and Bases views lack focused Notion-style navigation, an aggregated task view and compact database presentation with covers and colored tags.

relations.evidence: The project initially borrowed from Notion's database presentation
the mobile sidebar follows ChatGPT's restrained layout
Disable the old native-reading-ui development plugin first if present
Choose the Codex system font or bundled LXGW WenKai, both available offline

summary: Notion-like workspace UI over Markdown and Bases: page sidebar, unified search, a reminders page, compact database tables, boards and inline editing.
